body.query: 按大区统计 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.resolved_query: 按大区统计 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE f.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000
body.feedback_comment: 结果正确但希望按品牌进一步拆分展示
